How fresh is this data?
  • 🏷️ Listings (for sale): live. Our bot watches the blockchain and updates within minutes.
  • 👤 Owners, locks, retired seats, packs: fully refreshed about once a week. A moment sold or gifted since the last refresh may still show its previous owner for a few days.
  • 💵 Sales history and true value: refreshed about once a week from completed Top Shot marketplace sales.
  • 💝 Gifts: any VC moment that moved between two collectors without a Top Shot sale. This can include Flowty or private deals and moves between someone's own accounts.
  • 📅 Joined Top Shot: from each collector's public profile, as of the last refresh.

Each page shows when owners and listings were last updated. This is an unofficial fan site, not affiliated with NBA Top Shot, Dapper Labs or the NBA. Spot something wrong? DM @VC15Tracker on X.
